subject.title: Feature: Respect userTimezone in memory file timestamps and naming

question: Should bundled session-memory filenames and `# Session` headers use `agents.defaults.userTimezone` instead of host/TZ local time when the two differ?
rationale: Current docs and shipped behavior define session-memory as host-local, but memory auto-flush already uses configured `userTimezone`, so changing this would align memory surfaces while altering existing artifact names.

options.title: Adopt `userTimezone` for session-memory
options.body: Make session-memory filenames, fallback HHMM slugs, and headers use the resolved configured user timezone, with regression tests for host timezone mismatch.

options.title: Keep host-local session-memory
options.body: Preserve the shipped hook behavior and document that `userTimezone` does not apply to these artifacts.

options.title: Add a separate memory timezone
options.body: Add a new explicit memory artifact timezone setting, accepting the extra config surface and migration/docs work.

recommendation.title: Adopt `userTimezone` for session-memory
recommendation.body: Make session-memory filenames, fallback HHMM slugs, and headers use the resolved configured user timezone, with regression tests for host timezone mismatch.
